subject: technology
title: Advanced Algorithms and Computational Limits
standards: Michigan Computer Science: Algorithms and Programming
essential_question: When a problem has no efficient exact solution, what do we do instead?
performance_task: Solve a constrained optimization or graph problem and defend the algorithm choice with complexity reasoning.

subject: technology
title: Systems, Concurrency, and Performance
essential_question: Why is fast code hard, and how do we know an optimization did not break correctness?
performance_task: Profile and optimize a supplied program, documenting measurements, tradeoffs, and correctness under concurrency.

subject: technology
title: Applied Cybersecurity, Privacy Engineering, and Risk
standards: Michigan Computer Science: Networks and the Internet — Cybersecurity
essential_question: How do we design for privacy and security before there is anything to attack?
topics: risk assessment and threat modeling at scale
secure architecture and defense in depth
privacy by design and data minimization
performance_task: Produce a security and privacy engineering review for a fictional system with a risk register and an incident-response plan; all work stays in a sandbox and no live system is tested.

subject: technology
title: Computing Ethics, Law, Policy, and Societal Impact
standards: Michigan Computer Science: Impacts of Computing
essential_question: Who is accountable when software causes harm, and what does the law actually require?
performance_task: Write an evidence-based policy analysis of a computing practice with stakeholder, legal, and equity findings.

subject: technology
title: Capstone Design, Build, and Test
standards: Michigan Computer Science: Algorithms and Programming
essential_question: How do we build something substantial and prove, at each step, that it works?
performance_task: Build the capstone system to a testable milestone with verified requirements, automated tests, and accessibility evidence.

subject: technology
title: Capstone Review, Defense, and Transition
standards: Michigan Computer Science: Impacts of Computing
essential_question: What does it mean to defend your own work honestly, including its limits?
topics: presentation in a chosen private or public mode
performance_task: Defend the capstone in a chosen private or public mode with complete documentation, a response to independent review, and a maintenance and transition plan.
